svg.title: Two scales of lipid regulation.
svg.desc: Enzyme kinetics and metabolic switching in their cellular context.
svg.text: Enzyme kinetics and metabolic switching in their cellular context.
Substrates, enzyme-bound chains, CoA and products.
Fitted to in-vitro C14:0 / C16:0 / C18:0 time courses.
Product identities shown; glyph size does not encode yield.
Four pools: acetyl-CoA, malonyl-CoA, fatty acids, TG.
Open, lumped model; compartments are not resolved.
Question: when can synthesis–oxidation switching occur?
Complementary models; no fitted parameter transfer between them is claimed.
Solid arrows: conversion / transport · dashed T-bars: inhibition · block bar: disease context, not a measured flux.
